title: ὁ Διναύσαρος ἀγοράζει ἄρτον
learning_goal: Practice infinitive verbs with βούλομαι, δεῖ, and πεινάω, plus trade verbs πωλέω and ἀγοράζω.
plot: Dinosaur gets hungry at home, realizes he needs to buy bread, travels to the agora, purchases bread from Emporos with coins, and satisfies his hunger.

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.
positioning: Dinosaur stands in the center of the room looking around calmly
motivations: Dinosaur is content and relaxed because he is safely at home

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος πεινᾷ. βούλεται φαγεῖν ἄρτον.
positioning: Dinosaur holds his belly with both hands and has a longing expression on his face
motivations: Dinosaur is hungry and uncomfortable because he hasn't eaten and really wants some bread

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος ζητεῖ ἄρτον, ἀλλὰ οὐκ εὑρίσκει ἄρτον.
objects: an empty wooden bread basket on the table
positioning: Dinosaur looks into the empty wooden bread basket with a disappointed expression
motivations: Dinosaur is frustrated and disappointed because he searched for bread but found none in the house

frames.text: δεῖ τὸν Διναύσαρον ἀγοράζειν ἄρτον. δεῖ ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: an empty wooden bread basket on the table
positioning: Dinosaur points toward the door with determination while looking at the empty basket
motivations: Dinosaur is determined and purposeful because he realizes he must go to the market to buy bread

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας.
objects: several silver coins in his hand
positioning: Dinosaur walks through the doorway holding several silver coins in his hand
motivations: Dinosaur is focused and ready because he has his coins and is heading out to buy bread

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος βαδίζει πρὸς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: several silver coins in his hand
positioning: Dinosaur walks along the path between his house and the agora, still holding his coins
motivations: Dinosaur is hopeful and eager because he is on his way to buy the bread he needs

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: several silver coins in his hand
positioning: Dinosaur steps through the agora entrance looking around at the market stalls
motivations: Dinosaur is excited and alert because he has arrived at the market where he can buy bread

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν Ἔμπορον.
objects: several silver coins in his hand
positioning: Dinosaur walks toward Emporos who stands behind his stall
Emporos looks up at the approaching customer with a welcoming expression
motivations: Dinosaur is focused and purposeful because he has found the merchant who can sell him bread
Emporos is welcoming and attentive because a customer approaches his stall

frames.text: ὁ Ἔμπορος ἔχει ἄρτον καὶ μῆλα καὶ ὕδωρ.
objects: several silver coins in his hand
three round loaves of bread on the stall
red apples arranged in a basket
clay water jars on the counter
positioning: Emporos gestures proudly at his goods displayed on the stall
Dinosaur looks eagerly at the bread with hungry eyes
Three round loaves of bread sit prominently on the stall
Red apples are arranged in a basket
Clay water jars stand on the counter
motivations: Emporos is proud and hopeful because he has good wares to sell to the hungry customer
Dinosaur is excited and relieved because he sees the bread he desperately wants

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος δίδωσι νομίσματα τῷ Ἐμπόρῳ.
objects: several silver coins being exchanged
three round loaves of bread on the stall
red apples arranged in a basket
clay water jars on the counter
positioning: Dinosaur extends his hand giving coins to Emporos
Emporos reaches out to receive the silver coins with a satisfied smile
Several silver coins are being passed between them
motivations: Dinosaur is eager and determined because he is paying for the bread he needs
Emporos is pleased and businesslike because he is making a good sale

frames.text: ὁ Ἔμπορος δίδωσι ἄρτον τῷ Διναυσάρῳ.
objects: one round loaf of bread being given
red apples arranged in a basket
clay water jars on the counter
positioning: Emporos hands a loaf of bread to Dinosaur with a generous expression
Dinosaur receives the bread eagerly with both hands
motivations: Emporos is satisfied and generous because he has completed a fair trade
Dinosaur is grateful and excited because he finally has the bread he wanted

frames.text: ὁ Διναύσαρος ἐσθίει τὸν ἄρτον. οὐκέτι πεινᾷ.
objects: one round loaf of bread being eaten
red apples arranged in a basket
clay water jars on the counter
positioning: Dinosaur takes a big bite of the bread with a contented smile
Emporos watches approvingly from behind his stall
motivations: Dinosaur is happy and satisfied because he is no longer hungry after eating the bread
Emporos is pleased and proud because his customer is satisfied with the purchase
